title: Windows is the only tested platform today
context: OpenKaava is built on Tauri v2, which supports all three platforms. The development machine runs Windows.
decision: Every prerequisite in the repository is a Windows prerequisite. Nobody has built the orchestrator on macOS or Linux. This is a statement about what has been tested, not a decision to exclude anything.
consequences: Breaking changes on other platforms would not be noticed. If someone wants to port it, that is welcome and real work: the prerequisites, a CI runner, and someone who notices when it goes red. An issue should be opened before work starts.
